name: neovim
description_en: Vim-fork focused on extensibility and usability
readme_excerpt: Documentation | Chat Neovim is a project that seeks to aggressively refactor Vim in order to: - Simplify maintenance and encourage contributions - Split the work between multiple developers - Enable [advanced UIs] without modifications to the core - Maximize extensibility See the Introduction wiki page and [Roadmap] for more information. Features - Modern GUIs - API access from any language including C/C++, C#, Clojure, D, Elixir, Go, Haskell, Java/Kotlin, JavaScript/Node.js, Julia, Lisp, Lua,…
